scope: Source review of the nine first-party package matches; not a claim that arbitrary prompt injection is solved or that fork version numbers equal upstream patch versions.

review.status: specific reported HTTP-only validation defect has an existing WebSocket guard and executed regression coverage
review.detail: The WebSocket path independently validates Host and web Origin before credential handling; actual WebSocket tests reject hostile Host and cross-site Origin, and accept loopback/declared public hosts. Android does not gain a new unauthenticated dashboard listener through this PR.
review.limit: Deliberately exposed optional dashboard configurations and non-web origins still require their documented credential/network boundaries. This review does not certify every deployment topology.

review.status: existing owner-only file protections found; no newly exposed Android storage path
review.detail: ResponseStore tightens database, WAL and SHM permissions to 0600 during initialization. Webhook secret storage uses atomic_json_write(mode=0600), securing the temporary file before rename. These sources are not changed by the v159 HTTP update.
review.limit: The database permission change occurs after SQLite initialization; no claim of proving every creation-race or external-filesystem behavior. Existing broadly exposed user-selected storage and same-UID code are separate trust boundaries.

review.status: reported nonempty-string opt-in defect already mitigated in current source
review.detail: Project plugin discovery uses the shared env_var_enabled predicate rather than treating any nonempty string as enabled. Values such as false, no and 0 do not silently enable project plugin discovery.
review.limit: A user who explicitly trusts and enables a project plugin is permitting plugin code execution; this is not an arbitrary-code sandbox.

review.status: reported assignment-splitting behavior already removed from current source
review.detail: Sanitization normalizes line whitespace but treats content after the first equals sign as value data. It does not promote a recognized variable name embedded in a value into a second assignment.
review.limit: Explicit configuration changes remain privileged user actions.

review.status: reported unbounded webhook read has existing size, time and rate limits
review.detail: The optional Feishu webhook enforces a 1 MiB body cap before JSON decoding, bounded streaming reads, a 30-second body deadline, per-IP rate limits and bounded rate-key tracking. Oversized or stalled requests are rejected. The adapter is not automatically made a public listener by the Android app.
review.limit: Deployments that enable this optional platform still require transport/authentication and resource planning; no public service penetration test was run.

review.status: current centralized scanner and behavioral tests retained; general prompt-injection risk remains
review.detail: Current skill checks use the shared threat scanner instead of relying only on the earlier isolated pattern table. The selected behavioral suite passed; protection was not deleted to silence the advisory.
review.limit: Pattern coverage is not a proof that hostile prose can never influence a model. This advisory is not globally suppressed or declared universally inapplicable.

review.status: strict memory-content scanning present; semantic injection remains a residual risk
review.detail: Persisted memory mutations are checked through the shared strict threat scope. The executed memory and scanner tests are retained, not bypassed.
review.limit: Regex/heuristic filtering alone does not establish a complete semantic security boundary.

review.status: matching context-file threats are blocked in current source; universal injection resistance not claimed
review.detail: Detected context threats produce a BLOCKED placeholder rather than loading the original content with only a warning. Context and strict scopes remain distinct so ordinary source documentation is not indiscriminately disabled.
review.limit: Unmatched semantic instructions are still a research/security concern; this is not a reason to mark all prompt-injection advisories fixed by a version bump.

review.status: compression trust/role behavior reviewed; residual model-mediated injection not closed
review.detail: Current compression uses summary/handoff metadata and explicit message-role handling rather than treating a fork package version as evidence of a security patch. The retained compressor suite passed.
review.limit: The test suite does not prove that every adversarial conversation summary cannot influence later generation. Keep this source-level concern visible and do not add an OSV ignore.
